verdict.why_en: The framework landed on Hold. The $60B backlog and 7.28x forward P/E are real — but so are negative FCF, 5.7% margins, an unresolved export probe, and overbought technicals. The evidence is balanced, so the desk holds.
verdict.why_zh: 框架给出Hold评级：600亿积压和7.28倍前瞻PE真实有力，但负自由现金流、5.7%利润率、未解的出口调查和超买技术信号同样真实。证据平衡，框架不做方向押注。

stances.en: 44% revenue CAGR and a $60B backlog scream AI dominance.
stances.zh: 44%收入复合增速+600亿积压订单，AI统治力毋庸置疑。

stances.en: News flow is overwhelmingly positive post-blockbuster earnings.
stances.zh: 财报超预期后新闻面极度乐观。

stances.en: Export-control probe and negative cash flow are unshaken risks.
stances.zh: 出口管制调查和负现金流风险尚未解除。

stances.en: Price above all MAs, but RSI at 70 and above the upper Bollinger Band.
stances.zh: 价格站上所有均线，但RSI逼近70且已突破布林带上轨。

split.bull_en: 44% revenue CAGR and a $60B backlog scream AI dominance.
split.bull_zh: 44%收入复合增速+600亿积压订单，AI统治力毋庸置疑。
split.bear_en: Export-control probe and negative cash flow are unshaken risks.
split.bear_zh: 出口管制调查和负现金流风险尚未解除。
split.pivot_en: The bull sees the $60B backlog and 7.28x forward P/E as proof of a cheap AI leader. The bear sees negative FCF, 5.7% margins, and a stock up 101% YTD — calling it a frothy hardware middleman.
split.pivot_zh: 多头认为600亿积压+前瞻PE仅7.28倍证明SMCI是被低估的AI龙头；空头指出自由现金流为负、利润率仅5.7%、年内已涨101%，认为这只是泡沫化的硬件中间商。
